meta.description: Signature move per species for the pet's attack: Korean from the official Korean Digimon reference (digimon.net/reference_ko), English from the Japanese original (digimon.net/reference_en, or Wikimon where reference_en uses a dub name). kind picks one of the drawn attack shapes: fire, missile, gaia, claw, ice, bind (tentacles, vines, threads, whips). Sources and notes per move: tools/digimon/research/moves-*.json and docs/digimon.

siesamon.note: its first listed move (Sekkantou) is a defensive barrier
